user.title: Pareto
user.description: Pareto learns which entities you actually operate and publishes the most used and most recent ones as sensors. There is nothing to configure here — everything is available afterwards under Configure.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Pareto is already set up. Only one instance is needed.

data_description.half_life_days: How fast past usage loses weight. At 14 days, something used a fortnight ago counts half as much as today.
data_description.include_domains: Leave empty to allow every domain.
data_description.pinned_entities: Shown first, in this order, even if never used. Pinned entities count towards the numbers above.

import_history.name: Import history
import_history.description: Reads past usage from the logbook. Only fills days that hold no data yet, so running it twice is safe.

days.name: Days
days.description: How far back to read. Limited by your recorder retention, typically 10 days.
